note: Private campground on a wooded peninsula on Lake Thompson, south of Rhinelander, with a heated pool, a small sand beach, a pier and boat rentals. Its own map marks the 48-71 loop and a few sites on the other loop as seasonal; the rest take nightly campers. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: FHU $45 summer / $38 off season (+$3/day A/C), 45 FHU + 10 tent + 5 cabins, holiday 3-night minimums, cash/check, PA park. Google 3.8 (80) = DROP CANDIDATE (under 4 with 25+ reviews); 2026 RV Life reviews complain of low water pressure, unlevel dirt sites. Not waterfront kept. No gateway; price passes ($48 with A/C).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (Google under 4 with 25+ reviews): Google Maps 3.8 from 80 reviews (read 2026-11-16). Supporting: RV Life 5/2026 '$45 ... Dirt sites, not very level. Lots of old leaves everywhere-not well kept up. Path to lake steep and no real beach'; 7/2026 'water pressure is very low'; 5/2025 'pressure was only 24 psi'. No --AWH note on this entry.
PRICE GATE: pass - $45 a night summer for a full-hookup site for 4, $48 if the A/C is used ('$3 a day extra'); no gateway within 40 km; not a Good Sam park.

LONG-STAY: the operator's map marks about 28 numbered sites seasonal (12-14 and roughly the whole 48-71 loop) of ~80 numbers drawn; the operator's own count is 45 full-hookup + 10 tent, so the numbering is not continuous. Nightly is the clear majority (~2/3). No discouraging wording. Monthly $800, seasonal $2,850 posted alongside nightly.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept for the RV sites. The operator's map draws tent/primitive sites 81-88 along the west shore by the lakeshore parking lot (~45.6315,-89.3475); imagery shows that shore under continuous canopy, and they are tent/primitive sites (no hookups) - at most a lakeview lead for those 8, not for the RV loops. The stored evidence ('only private cabins sit at the shore') misses those sites; cabins 1-6 are on the north tip by the beach/boat launch.

UNSOURCED stored values: hookups.electric 50 and sites.max_rig_ft 50 come from an Explore Rhinelander listing via note prose; the operator says only 'water sewer electric' and asks unit length on its form. Left (hookups not rewritten).

PIN 45.6304,-89.3492 is in the woods on the peninsula's southwest side, ~150-200 m from the loops' centre (~45.6305,-89.3470) and ~240 m from Google's point (45.6297552,-89.3461475, the entrance on South Shore Drive). Under 250 m, left.
